# Akash Tourism

> Thoughtful travel planning for memorable journeys across India.

Akash Tourism is a travel website focused on curated journeys through Delhi, Agra, Jammu & Kashmir, and Himachal Pradesh. The site combines destination inspiration, practical travel packages, and field notes from the road.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://akashjourney.com/): Explore curated Indian destinations and travel inspiration.
- [Services](https://akashjourney.com/services): Journey design, handpicked stays, local experiences, and seamless movement.
- [About Us](https://akashjourney.com/about): Akash Tourism's story, values, and travel philosophy.
- [Privacy Policy](https://akashjourney.com/privacy): Information about privacy and data handling.
- [Contact Us](https://akashjourney.com/contact): Start a conversation about planning your next journey.
- [Travel Blog](https://akashjourney.com/blog): Travel stories, local recommendations, and field notes.

## Destinations

- [Delhi](https://akashjourney.com/delhi): Food, heritage, bazaars, and the energy of India's capital.
- [Agra](https://akashjourney.com/agra): Taj Mahal, Mughal heritage, marble craft, and Mehtab Bagh.
- [Jammu & Kashmir](https://akashjourney.com/jammu-kashmir): Alpine landscapes, Dal Lake, houseboats, and slow mountain travel.
- [Himachal Pradesh](https://akashjourney.com/himachal-pradesh): Pine forests, mountain cafes, homestays, and unhurried journeys.

## Travel Packages

- Delhi: 2 Days / 1 Night
- Agra: 2 Days / 1 Night
- Jammu & Kashmir: 4 Days / 3 Nights
- Himachal Pradesh: 5 Days / 4 Nights
